searchText: b"h phase one — unbounded brainstorm the awtsmoos renews every frame and every test; this plan seeks every vessel where motion, story, persistence, and pixels may still conceal unfinished work. possible completion fronts repository archaeology: source graph, imports, scripts, generated proofs, ignored media, worktree state, stale checkpoints, and hidden regressions. character identity: neutral facial landmarks, head shape, body mass, posture, hair, wardrobe, reusable saved identity, and separation from performance state. face performance: deterministic blink, gaze, convergence, eye targets, head turn, eyebrow regions, eyelids, phoneme timing, visemes, and mouth geometry. body performance: breathing, lean, weight shift, locomotion, gesture preparation/stroke/hold/follow through/retraction, and contact locks. geometry readability: hands, fingers, crossed arms, pocket hands, palms, point, wave, shoes, heel/toe/sole direction, garments, hair, sleeve drag, hem lift, and secondary motion. cinematic systems: multiple views, shot vocabulary, automatic framing, camera continuity, title cards, text boxes, captions, dialogue timing, and scene timing. persistence: customizer data, save/load, import/export, startup restoration, transient exclusion, project packaging, and media durability. rendering: preview/export parity, production canvas, browser state, exact dimensions, nonblank pngs, hashes, frame sampling, and final video/audio metadata. quality: small scale legibility, visual courts, accessibility, performance, blank shell detection, cropping, text safety, and narrative clarity. orchestration: sequential agent spawning, isolated scopes, evidence contracts, merge queue, conflict control, reassignment, and master verification. future possibilities: deterministic replay, golden frame comparisons, automated perceptual metrics, export manifest signing, and richer demo variations. work graph principle every feature must trace through source state → normalization → composition → render bridge → geometry → production pixels → persistence → preview → export → test → proof. no module name, prior report, or passing smoke alone closes a node.
